description: What changed on a page. First call returns a snapshot_id; call again with since=<snapshot_id> to get only the added, removed, and changed lines (e.g. a price going from $29 to $39) instead of re-reading the page. Snapshots last 30 days. Or pass compare=<second url> to diff two pages directly. Works on HTML, PDFs, and text. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

compare.description: Second URL to diff against url directly

since.description: snapshot_id from a previous call; returns changes since then

name: diff
title: Page change monitor
